params.text: A spatial execution environment where code routing becomes a living honeycomb topology: bee-line vectors, sub-hives and worker nodes you can drag, re-parent and re-route by hand.
v1.0.0  ·  built with figcraft-cli  ·  deterministic, zero GUI
12 artboards  ·  20 paint styles  ·  13 text styles  ·  3 depth styles  ·  21 colour variables

Warm ink on honey paper. Every value is either sampled from the supplied canvas reference or inherited from the shipped app tokens, or derived and recorded as derived. Token names map 1:1 to FigCraft colour variables.
Two working families plus one mono. Declared app fonts were audited against what this machine actually resolves -- see the availability strip at the bottom.
Every control, card, table and body string
Code, tokens, hex values, event names
Drop a repository into the core hive and the HyperAgent maps its architecture before a single worker spawns.
RESOLVED HERE: Playfair Display  ·  Inter  ·  Consolas

NOT INSTALLED HERE: JetBrains Mono.  The app self-hosts Instrument Serif (@fontsource, 8 woff files in web/dist) so the product resolves it, but this FigCraft machine cannot -- Playfair stands in on the boards.
A 4px base, six radii and three elevation tiers. Shadows are warm-ink (never neutral grey) so depth stays inside the honey palette.
the hive itself, behind the chat
One mark, four lockups, one clear-space rule. The bee always flies toward the route direction -- it is a routing arrow, not decoration.

Never below 16px. Below 24px drop the inner bee
and keep the hexagon silhouette only.

Wordmark min 20px. Mono 1-colour lockup is the
fallback for single-ink print and embroidery.
Five node types share one anatomy: name, role tag, live state and progress. Colour is reserved for state -- honey = healthy, crimson = broken route -- so a swarm can be read from across the canvas.

The HyperAgent tree and the live swarm graph are the same object: re-parent a worker only while it is not streaming; every edge is a bee line, never decoration.
re-parent only while not streaming · kill/rewire are confirmation-first

colour is never the only channel
One operator surface for the mesh: importable profiles, a clearable memory, the cross-branch mailbox, project identity, usage counters and nonce-bound message approval.
Import a folder or a .figcraft manifest; nothing executes at import time.
Clear is confirmation-first; the ledger is append-only.
Mailbox is read-only; delivery is a branch event.
APPROVAL_RESOLVE · nonce · single-use grant · TTL 120 s
Approve executes no effect by itself; it grants the engine one consume.
Every failure is a named refusal; every wait has a state; nothing is a silent drop. Replay is read-only and the diff surface stays DECISION-GATED until its commands are frozen.
